name: Chubu Shiryo Co., Ltd.
summary: Chubu Shiryo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells compound feed for livestock and fisheries in Japan. It operates through two segments, Feed and Other. The company offers animal feed, including poultry, pig, cattle, and fish feed; livestock and fishery products, such as sesame eggs, sweet potato pork, chicken, and Ebisu yellowtail to supermarkets and retailers; is involved in meat business; organic compound fertilizers; and livestock equipment. It also provides livestock medical services, such as livestock hygiene management, pathological testing, and instruction on breeding techniques, as well as livestock insurance. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
